findings.problem: The record of the five left turns is dimmed to FADE = 0.4 and then held for about 5 s (local 5.9 to 11). That dims TEXT: the five letters C D E G A (colour var(--text-dim), 30 px) fall to about 1.75:1 against white, and the green solid 'all left turns' pill (teal-on text on teal, 0.4 opacity) to about 1.67:1. Both are far below the 3:1 floor for dimmed text, so the pill and letters read as ghosts for the whole detour (the faded pill is exactly what earlier reviewers flagged).
findings.fix: Dim only the arrows (non-text) to about 0.4 and keep the letters at full opacity (text-dim is 5.3:1 on white; it needs opacity 0.72 for 3:1 and 0.93 for 4.5:1). For the 'all left turns' pill either keep it at o 1 or fade it right out (o 0 by 5.9) when the detour starts; never leave it half faded. In code: line 217 rec = lerp(1, FADE, ...) is applied to icons, letters (line 222) and allLeft (line 223): apply it to icons only, and give allLeft o: 1 - ramp(t, 5.5, 5.9).
findings.evidence: s4@7.0, s4@8.0 and s4@10.0 (global 37, 38, 40): pale letters under the pale arrows and a washed-out 'all left turns' pill. DOM scan: those texts sit at opacity 0.33 to 0.4 from local 5.75 to the scene end.

findings.problem: Dimmed text far below 3:1, in two stages. (1) From 3.6 s the inside points B and F get o *= lerp(1, 0.5) (line 76), and from 7.9 s the whole plot is dimmed again by dim = 0.6 (line 69, passed as o to pl.update), so the B and F letters end at opacity 0.3 (about 1.7:1) and stay there for about 6.5 s. (2) The same dim 0.6 is applied to the 'pairs' counter, the '7 points' tag and, through the plot, the 'hull' and orange 'farthest pair' tags (and the A C D E G letters) for the last 2.5 s: label text lands at 2.3 to 2.6:1 (text-dim on panel-2 at 0.6 is 2.33:1, amber-on on amber 2.58:1, teal-on on teal 2.42:1). This is the 'faded pills and tiles' problem again.
findings.fix: Do not stack two opacities. Keep text at 0.75 or more (ink reaches 3:1 at 0.55 and 4.5:1 at 0.70; text-dim needs 0.72 for 3:1). Suggested: B and F fade to o 0.75 at most (the 'inside' tags and the dropped segments already carry the message; or swap to a dashed ghost rim like the stack tiles in scene 7), and replace dim = lerp(1, 0.6, ...) by something that does not touch text: dim only the segments and discs (pass o via the segs and point fills), or keep dim >= 0.75 and take the 'pairs', '7 points', 'hull' and 'farthest pair' tags to o 1 / fade them out completely before the big counters arrive (goal already does: o 1 - ramp(t, 7.7, 7.95)).
findings.evidence: s9@4.5 (global 97.5): B and F letters pale on the tint. s9@10.5 (global 103.5): 'pairs 10', '7 points', 'hull' and 'farthest pair' washed out above the full-strength 'all pairs' and 'corner pairs' counters. DOM scan: B and F at o 0.5 from local 4.25 and 0.3 from 8.5 to 10.5; pairs, 7 points, hull, A C D E G at 0.6 from 8.5 to 10.5.

findings.problem: A popped point is dimmed with opacity only: F ends at o 0.5 (line 194: lerp(1, 0.5)) and stays so for about 7.75 s (local 6.5 to 14.5), B for about 3.25 s. Its letter (ink on panel) is then about 2.7:1, under the 3:1 floor, and the pale 'F' / 'B' inside the pink ring is hard to read at the very moment the viewer should confirm which point was dropped. The same 0.5 (2.7:1) is used for the crossed-out F at the end of scene 4 (line 165, o lerp(0.35, 0.5), local 9 to 11), where the red cross is covering the letter anyway.
findings.fix: Keep the popped letter at o >= 0.7 (4.5:1) and take the 'gone' feeling from the grey tone, the dashed ghost rim (the tiles already use ghost: true) and the red ring, not from opacity. For scene 4 the cross already says it; use o 0.7 there too.
findings.evidence: s7@7.5, s7@14.9 (global 73.5 and 80.9): the pale F inside the ring. s4@10.0 (global 40). DOM scan: F at 0.5 for 30 samples in scene 7.

findings.problem: Stage margin under 12 px. Point A sits at stage x 50 (disc r 26) and its attention ring is r 39 with a 6 px stroke, so the ring reaches stage x 8, i.e. 8 px from the stage edge (12 px minimum). It happens in scene 5 when the loop closes (green ring on A, about 12.8 to 14.3 s) and in scene 9 where the orange ring on A is held from about 6.3 s to the end of the scene.
findings.fix: Shift the shared layout right by about 12 px, e.g. A5.pos({x: 62, s: 1.7}) in scenes 4 to 9 (E then ends near x 657, its ring at about 699, still clear of the right column at x 716), updating the position assertions in scene-05; or draw the ring on A at r + 9 only. Keep every scene on the same positions so the viewer still follows one point set.
findings.evidence: s5@13.5 (global 54.5) and s9@10.5 (global 103.5): the ring touches within about 8 px of the left edge of the stage. Measured from the SVG circle bounds: left margin 11 px at the circle geometry, 8 px with its 6 px stroke.

findings.problem: Pop and bump overshoot pushes a few stickers under the 12 px stage margin for about 0.3 s: the right-hand counters ('sweeps' scene 5, 'pairs' scene 9) sit exactly on the 12 px limit (x 716 to 924) and bump to 1.1x, leaving 2 to 5 px; the scene 8 key row is at stage y 12 exactly (11 px while it pops); the 'all pairs' counter in scene 9 is at x 12 and drops to about 7 px while it pops.
findings.fix: Move those columns and rows in by about 8 px (counters x 708, key row y 20, all-pairs x 20), or lower the bump to 1.05. Resting positions are fine.
findings.evidence: DOM scan of s5 near 13 s and 11.5 s, s8 near 3.5 s, s9 near 8.5 s (shape bounds against the 936 x 640 stage).

findings.problem: Undecided (grey) points have a rim of var(--line-2) #d4d4d4 on a white disc: 1.48:1 against the white canvas, so the pins and inside points look faint, most obviously the unlettered pins of scene 2 and the inside points B and F. The same grey is used for discs, the dash of candidate rays and the cup. It is a shape, not text, so not a break of the text rule, but it is the faintest thing on screen.
findings.fix: In A5.plot paintPoint use a stronger rim for the grey tone only, for example stroke var(--node-off-ic) (#afafaf, about 2.2:1) or var(--text-faint), keeping the lip as is. Do not change .c-grey in video.css, because the NIC videos share it.
findings.evidence: s2@3.0 and s2@4.2 (global 7.0 and 8.2): pale pins; s4@4.0 (global 34): B and F.

findings.problem: The kicker above each headline (.v-kicker in videos/video.css) is 24 px, under the 28 px label floor. It is engine chrome shared by every video in the series, not an a5 decision, and every other stage label in a5 measures 28 px or more (DOM scan of rendered sizes: only transient pop-in scales dip below 28).
findings.fix: Only if the series bar is raised: .v-kicker font-size 28px in video.css (it fits on one line for every a5 kicker, the longest is 'GRAHAM SCAN: THE STACK'). Otherwise leave as it is.
findings.evidence: DOM scan of all 10 scenes: .v-kicker 24 px on 9 scenes.

findings.problem: Row labels read as one sentence when the line breaks: 'Wrapping: swing a line / cost n × h' parses as 'a line cost', and 'Scan: sort, pop dents / cost n log n' has the same run-on. Plain words, UK spelling and the 22-character limit are otherwise fine.
findings.fix: Add a comma at the end of the first line: 'Wrap: swing a line,' / 'cost n × h' and 'Scan: sort, pop dents,' / 'cost n log n' (both within the 22-character check).
